account.title: Your details
account.description: Your name is yours to change. Your email address is what you sign in with, so changing it takes a link sent to the new address.

dialog.title: Change your email address
dialog.description: We will send a link to the new address. Nothing changes until you follow it, and you keep signing in with your current address until then.

newEmail.label: New email address
newEmail.description: The link goes here, so it has to be an address you can open.

currentPassword.label: Current password
currentPassword.description: Required even though you are signed in — a changed address is where every future password-reset link would go.

password.title: Password
password.note: You will be asked for your current password, even though you are signed in. Your other devices stay signed out until you use the new password on them.

dialog.title: Change your password
dialog.description: Signing out your other devices is the point of a password change, so it is not optional. Nothing will ask you to change it again afterwards.

currentPassword.label: Current password
currentPassword.description: Required even though you are signed in — someone who found this tab open must not be able to set a new password.

newPassword.label: New password
newPassword.description: Every other device is signed out. This one stays signed in.

methods.title: Sign-in methods
methods.description: The ways you can sign in to this account.

password.on: You sign in with your email address and password.
password.off: No password yet — you sign in with Google.
password.sent: Check your inbox: a link for choosing a password is on its way to {{email}}. It can be used once and expires.

google.label: Google
google.onlyWay: Google is the only way into this account. Set a password before you unlink it.

notice.linked: Google is linked. You can sign in with it from now on.
notice.linkFailed: Linking Google did not finish. It may have taken too long, or been finished in a different browser. Try again.

methods.passwordFirst: This asks for your current password, and your account does not have one yet. Set a password first.

unlink.title: Unlink Google
unlink.description: You will no longer be able to sign in with this Google account. Your password stays, and nobody is signed out.

currentPassword.label: Current password
currentPassword.description: Required even though you are signed in — unlinking removes a way into your account.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Closing your account signs you out everywhere, this device included.
delete.note: We keep the record of the account, but it can no longer be used to sign in, and your email address becomes free to sign up with again. Nothing in this app can reopen a closed account.

dialog.title: Delete your account
dialog.description: You will be asked for your current password. Read what happens first — this app has no way to undo it.

consequences.signedOut: Every device is signed out, including this one.
consequences.noSignIn: The account is closed and can no longer be used to sign in.
consequences.email: Your email address becomes free to sign up with again.
consequences.kept: We keep the record of the account itself; it is not erased, and nothing here can reopen it.

currentPassword.label: Current password
currentPassword.description: Required even though you are signed in — someone who found this tab open must not be able to close your account.

outcomes.passwordChanged: Your password was changed. Every other device was signed out; this one stays.
outcomes.deleted: Your account is closed. You have been signed out on every device.
outcomes.emailChangeRequested: A confirmation link is on its way to the new address. Nothing changes until you follow it.
outcomes.identityUnlinked: Google is unlinked. Sign in with your password from now on.
